content: A Knowledge room can be created once vectorization works. Contact the Full admin to configure the embeddings provider.

comment.text: Tooltip over the greyed-out Knowledge room option in the New room chooser of the AI rooms section, shown to a room admin who cannot change portal settings while vectorization (turning files into searchable embeddings for the AI chat) is not working; tells them to ask the Full admin (the portal administrator role) to configure the embeddings provider. Knowledge room is a room type name.
